source.title: Night City 2045
source.note: Held-out v0.2 Review Queue candidates source-reviewed directly against the user-provided purchased book. Factual metadata and concise paraphrases only; source prose is not reproduced.

entities.name: The Basement
entities.source_summary: Pawnshop in the surviving basement of the former Japan Trade Center, run by Fixer Yomotsu Hirasaka; common inexpensive goods are public while rarer and more expensive merchandise is shown to customers who impress the owner.

local_offerings.label: Cheap pawned goods and common collectibles

services.label: Purchase and resale of customers’ goods

entities.catalogue_note: The source explicitly gates rarer inventory by relationship with the proprietor. A generic pawn assortment would erase that distinction, so merchandise remains source-local.

entities.name: Highcourt Plaza Hotel
entities.source_summary: Upscale hotel offering pools, spas, high-quality meals and unusually secure accommodation, with Aerocab transport arranged for guests.

entities.name: Imperial Bank
entities.source_summary: Former conventional bank reduced to a payday-loan business charging very high interest; ordinary banking services are no longer offered.

entities.name: Oni-Yama Jail
entities.source_summary: Kimen-Gumi detention site where detainees may pay a fine, be transferred for prosecution, or be compelled into labor for the Tyger Claws and associated businesses; this is coercive detention, not a customer-facing commercial service.

entities.name: Unnamed Cube Hotel
entities.source_summary: Automated, minimally secured cube hotel with electronic lobby-vendit payment and no on-site staff.
